experiments_or_tasks: Analyze the distribution of features at the output layer of deep GCNs using the GP framework.
Derive Gaussian process (GP) equivalence for deep GCNs in the limit of infinitely many hidden features.
Generalize the concept of propagation depth of information from DNNs to GCNs using the linearization of the GCN GP.
Identify a non-oversmoothing phase where node features remain informative at large depth if initial weight variance is sufficiently large.
